recognize_zh: 肝臟針刺切片的高倍 H&E 中，整個視野被大型異型細胞片狀取代，細胞核大小不一、深染，部分核仁可見，夾雜凋亡小體與擠壓變形的細胞，看不到正常肝細胞板，符合淋巴瘤浸潤肝臟。
features: Diffuse sheets of large atypical cells replacing the field
Pleomorphic, hyperchromatic to vesicular nuclei with occasional visible nucleoli
High N:C ratio with scant to moderate cytoplasm
Scattered apoptotic bodies and crushed, smeared nuclei
No recognizable hepatocyte plates or portal structures in this field
describe_en: Core biopsy of the liver at high power shows effacement by diffuse sheets of large atypical cells with pleomorphic, vesicular to hyperchromatic nuclei, occasional nucleoli, and high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios. Apoptotic bodies are present, and some cells show crush artifact. No residual hepatocyte plates are identified in this field. Image resolution limits assessment of fine nuclear detail. Findings are consistent with involvement by a high-grade large-cell neoplasm, and with immunohistochemistry, diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, germinal center type.

ddx.vs: Tumor cells have abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, trabecular architecture, and are HepPar-1/arginase-1 positive and CD45 negative.
Shows cohesive nests or gland formation with keratin positivity and no lymphoid marker expression.
Involves sinusoids of intact hepatic parenchyma with medium-sized cells that are CD3+ and CD20 negative rather than forming mass-like sheets.
Composed of monotonous medium-sized cells with a starry-sky pattern and MYC rearrangement rather than pleomorphic large cells.
